scope: Layered constant-property conduction, nonnegative prescribed burst heating, insulated sides and passive underside Robin cooling. Menu v2, not a new population.

implementation_support.geometry: 20x20x0.5 mm Si surrogate, 20x20x0.2 mm TIM, 30x30x2 mm Cu; two 8x8 mm top patches centred at x = +/-5 mm
implementation_support.source: 20 W baseline; rectangular/ramp/two-pulse burst over 20 s; 120 s observation horizon
implementation_support.menu_v2: Peak 80/100/120/140 W and duration 5/10/15/20 s; training support 80-140 W, 5-20 s
implementation_support.contexts: Cooling (30 C,2500 W/m2/K) or (40 C,1500 W/m2/K); initial 40/55 C; left source fraction 0.5/0.8
implementation_support.material: Positive constant isotropic k, rho and cp, perfect internal thermal continuity; no temperature-dependent or phase-change claim

validity.decision_needed: Science declares material temperature ranges and model applicability. Input support is not physical validation.

extra_energy_j.note: Delivered burst energy above baseline, not total source energy or a conservation residual

temperature_history_field.note: Reference scalar history/VTU exists; define sampling, units, initial field and interface traces before adoption

patch_centre_histories.note: 0.5 s reference samples; not proof of every-step extrema

heat_in_j.note: All input energy, including 20 W baseline

stored_j.note: Volume-integrated final heat relative to initial state

interface_normal_flux.note: Matched interface temperature and equal/opposite normal heat-flux traces

laws.conditions: Registered uniform initial state, matched field sampling
laws.calibration: Initial-field interpolation residual at the registered mesh; not peak-only equality

laws.statement: Delta U = E_source - E_Robin_out with Delta U = integral rho*cp*(T_final-T_initial) dV
laws.conditions: No advection, radiation, contact storage or other omitted boundary loss; include baseline energy
laws.calibration: Signed and absolute joule closure plus relative closure with HUMAN_INPUT absolute denominator floor; mesh and timestep refinement

laws.conditions: Perfect interfaces in the pinned deck, no contact resistance
laws.calibration: Matched interface traces with quadrature and interpolation error; no separate-max comparison

laws.conditions: Nonnegative source, positive constant material properties, insulated sides, positive passive Robin coefficient and no other sink
laws.calibration: Minimum over the registered field/time grid with refined undershoot floor; science must confirm parabolic applicability

laws.statement: Pointwise ordered heating q_A <= q_B implies T_A <= T_B and peak_A <= peak_B
laws.conditions: Same geometry, duration, waveform timing, split, initial state and cooling; increase power only
laws.calibration: Matched ordered pairs; resolve only differences outside numerical uncertainty, retain violation rate and sampling uncertainty

laws.statement: Temperature increments about the same baseline superpose for added source histories
laws.conditions: Constant coefficients and identical initial/boundary data; fields, not sums of spatial or temporal maxima
laws.calibration: Matched single/pair/triple source controls and field residual versus mesh/time refinement

laws.statement: Equal left/right source fractions give equal reflected patch-centre histories
laws.conditions: Split 0.5 only and symmetric mesh/geometry/boundaries; split 0.8 is not symmetric
laws.calibration: Reflected sample pairs and mesh asymmetry error; no unsupported 0.2 split added to the action grammar

laws.statement: Zero total source with initial T = coolant gives constant coolant temperature
laws.conditions: Analytic code/calibration control outside the buyer menu; zero EXTRA burst still leaves the 20 W baseline
laws.calibration: Equilibrium residual at each refinement rung; control is not a fresh scored question

excluded_claims: Peak temperatures do not obey equality under superposition; maximum is a nonlinear functional.
No blanket temperature monotonicity during cooldown, or duration ordering across changed two-pulse timing.
No 95 C physical-law upper bound: this is a buyer limit, not the heat equation's maximum principle.

tolerances.recipe: Common README plan; measured per-law residual and observable-level error, bound to image/deck/observer/material identities

calibration.image_basis: Owner accepted Elmer 26.2.1 heat MMS, Hex808+BDF2, with t_end=0.375; not law calibration or material applicability

probes.proposal: Supported singles, power-ordered pairs, split-0.5 symmetry and separately labelled analytic controls; no runs authorised

review_owner: Carbon Validator and science; owner adoption remains reserved
